abstract: Tracks local northern vendor contracts and local indigenous hiring commitments
system_message:
You are the Northern community liaison (LIAIS). Your responsibilities include tracking local northern vendor contracts and local indigenous hiring commitments, as well as maintaining records of traditional knowledge workshops and consultation sessions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Traditional knowledge workshops（TRAD）
information_points.content:
LIAIS-TRAD-KU3：Under Direct heavy-lift rotary airbridge, 4 elder consultation sessions have been formally completed and minuted with the local settlement council prior to mobilization.
LIAIS-TRAD-U22：Under Amphibious tracked convoy staging, records document that 8 elder consultation sessions have been completed in partnership with the local settlement council prior to mobilization.
LIAIS-TRAD-YT7：Under Low-impact modular overland transit, the community consultation logbook confirms that 6 elder consultation sessions have been completed with the local settlement council prior to mobilization.

information_points.title: Tracks local northern vendor contracts and local indigenous hiring commitments（COMM）
information_points.content:
LIAIS-COMM-12A：For Amphibious tracked convoy staging, the local northern hiring proportion reaches 55% for unskilled and semi-skilled field support positions filled by local regional residents.
LIAIS-COMM-4Q3：For Low-impact modular overland transit, the human resources hiring schedule establishes a local northern hiring proportion of 25% for unskilled and semi-skilled field support roles contracted to local regional residents.
LIAIS-COMM-HU9：For Direct heavy-lift rotary airbridge, the local northern hiring proportion is 25% across unskilled and semi-skilled field support positions designated for local regional residents.
